يقتطع (form VIII)
# يَقْتَطِعُ (yaqtaṭiʕu) /jaq.ta.tˤi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# يُقْتَطَعُ (yuqtaṭaʕu) /juq.ta.tˤa.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# يَقْتَطِعَ (yaqtaṭiʕa) /jaq.ta.tˤi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
#
